peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 4.6% below its local comparables; 12 of 36 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (58.2): 3.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 30 of 55 similar developments with a figure (the same as 4). Context, not scored: resales in 33.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,500,000 ($1,642 psf, 828–936 sq ft; 5 resales, Oct 2024–Sep 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,722 psf (range $1,269–2,088); 4.6% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $73,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Rochor MRT about 130 m, Bugis MRT about 380 m; closer than 54 of 63 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest ST. Margaret's School (Primary) about 770 m; more than 17 of 63 similar developments (the same as 19). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 9 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 350 m), more than 45 of 63 similar developments (the same as 5); nearest hawker centre Albert Centre about 200 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 520 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 410 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 440 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 640 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 720 m; Midtown Bay, 4 new sales, about 830 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 950 m; Aurea, 39 new sales, about 1,460 m; Canninghill Piers, 8 new sales, about 1,460 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 267 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 253 new sales and 898 resales (1,151 purchases); new sales were 22% of these purchases. Subsales (48) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 750 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,390 m; Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,990 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 898 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 50 of 63 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 898 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 942 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−4.7%). Planning-area private resales −9.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
